g.title: G
g.text: ABBA Numerical Architecture - Method Instances and Common Integration
Module overview: physical, auxiliary-energy and fully extended strategies

g.title: cluster_coordinators
g.text: Method preparation, recipes and common integration

g.title: cluster_physical
g.text: Physical R2 kernels and optional energy sidecar

g.title: cluster_full
g.text: Fully extended R4 / duplicated R8 numerical kernels

g.title: cluster_shared
g.text: Nonlinear solvers, records, observation and results

g.title: ABBA4Implicit
g.text: one outer projection around all three

g.title: MidpointCoordinator
g.text: Explicit four-stage map and arithmetic mean.
Neither branch owns a time loop.

g.title: FullCoordinator
g.text: One accepted (x,y,t,k) state; two temporary R^4 copies.
Initialize implicit resources on the ABBA instance.
Midpoint initializes its own extended state and maps.
The common driver calls their ordinary class methods.

g.title: ProjectedCoordinator
g.text: SHARED BASE OF ABBA2 / ABBA4 / ABBA6
No separate family context or method adapter.
Concrete classes select order and supported placement.
The common driver handles history and observer dispatch.

g.title: FixedGrid
g.text: Run instance: initial_state, formulation, class operations
StepController: fixed and adaptive accepted-step contract
Collector owns history and metrics; method owns maps.
Observation and export are bound method operations.
_Progress updates here; ABBA uses fixed control.

g.title: EnergyTracking
g.text: kappa = k / 2 in R^N; no feedback into z

g.title: ComposedCoordinator
g.text: ABBA4: three signed maps, three projections
ABBA6: seven signed maps, seven projections
Each base map keeps its actual start and duration.

g.title: SingleCoordinator
g.text: One projection around three unprojected base maps.
Copies pass directly between the signed maps.
Return one ProjectedMapResult with three map traces.
Both reduced and simultaneous equations supported.
Placement is a numerical method choice.

g.title: ReducedProjection
g.text: Solve copy separation + 2 mu = 0; mu in R^(2N).

g.title: Records
g.text: PhysicalBaseMapTrace: signed interval and stage data
step_statistics extracts one row without storing it.
Sum work; retain the worst-ratio residual/tolerance pair.
Optional projection columns: one, three or seven.

g.title: Result
g.text: Requested history and copied metric rows per run.
finalize(): step_count, starts, ends, sizes, metric arrays.
No retained traces or observer events.
Merge metadata and legacy aliases → IntegrationData.
Read-only times, states, diagnostics and source.

g.title: Nonlinear
g.text: Shared convergence checks, errors and counters.
Zero corrections still means one residual evaluation.

g.title: FullTangent
g.text: Read accepted full-map traces after convergence.
Compose exact projected substep tangents when available.
Only the configured event builder requests this work.

g.title: Scope
g.text: for physical, energy-tracked physical, and fully extended paths.
Named local closures are shown with their owner.
Dashed arrows are optional energy, observer, or progress paths.
Other method families and unused compatibility helpers are outside scope.
